description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/ChannelListing/List. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Resolves one supplier product URL into validated product data for listing creation. ownerAgent: publication. Use when: Use when a user has submitted one concrete supplier product URL and needs the product data required to prepare a listing. Input: ListRequest body with Url and optional extension ExtraData. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Returns ComListing with validated product data when details can be obtained. A successful product response may also include OtherUrls so compatible extension clients can offer an optional switch to bulk publish. For a recognized product URL whose details cannot be obtained, returns Success=false with ErrorType=UnknownProduct without OtherUrls. Non-product pages may return OtherUrls for bulk discovery. Search terms: channellisting list. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.
